main.description: A requester submits an RFP to a bidder. The bidder records a bid intent and answers before it bids. Requires a service-auth JWT with lxm set to this NSID; the requester is the token issuer.

ingress.description: The com.publicdomainrelay.temp.ingress.webRTC offer records for this bidder. The bidder answers them in the reply with its own answer and listen records.

name.description: The bid intent the bidder recorded.

phase.description: The phase of the bid intent.

declined.description: Present when this bidder will not bid on the RFP, found by the checks of the bid decision that need no wait. The intent is recorded and fails as before.

kind.description: capacity: the bidder is full now (its running and reserved guests leave no room, or its host lacks the memory), another round may find room. unservable: nothing but another bidder will do (the compute kind, nestedVirt, images, a size above its maxCpus or maxMem, an image it cannot fetch or verify, guest tools or net it does not serve). A requester that finds every bidder it asked unservable fails at once with the reasons; it waits for capacity while any bidder is full or did not answer.

reason.description: Why, as the bidder's own words.

ingress.description: The bidder's com.publicdomainrelay.temp.ingress.webRTC answer and listen records for the request's offers, carrying the SDP and the bidder's STUN servers.
